title: After Dark, Nobody Leaves Their FLOOR 🔦
description:
My girlfriend and I took our first trip away together: a week in an old lighthouse on a cliff, in a February storm. She slept halfway up. I slept in the lamp room at the very top.

Every night she texted me the same question, and every night something at the bottom of the stairs was looking up.

It's made up. Built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment STAIRS if you'd have looked down.
